About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our Digital Transformation team, Airbus is looking for a

ERP(SAP) Platform & Infrastructure Technical Expert (m/w/d)

The Mission & Scope

Airbus Aerostructures is pioneering its digital transformation, and we are seeking a proactive SAP Technical Expert with a strong leadership mindset. You will bridge architectural vision and hands-on execution, ensuring seamless business continuity across our legacy systems while steering operational readiness for our S/4HANA Cloud transition.

Scope: Core ERP, EWM, GTS, Technical Solutions, S/4HANA Cloud, and SAP BTP.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Operations (On-Premise & Cloud): Act as the primary technical SME and lead deep-level administration, HANA DB optimization, trace analysis, and central infrastructure orchestration (Cloud Connectors, Web Dispatchers, STMS/ChaRM, SSO) across hybrid environments.
- Advanced S/4HANA Operations & Migrations: Lead S/4HANA conversion activities—including advanced SUM/DMO transitions—and manage S/4HANA Cloud testing landscapes, system refreshes, and target provisioning.
- Lifecycle Management, Monitoring & Automation: Drive system enhancements and release cycles, manage high-availability/disaster recovery setups, implement observability frameworks (SAP Cloud ALM / BTP), and design Infrastructure-as-Code workflows to automate standard BASIS routines.
- Security, Compliance & Audit Readiness: Enforce system hardening, patch orchestration, and SSL/TLS certificate management. Monitor security/gateway logs, remediate vulnerabilities, and lead technical preparations for internal and external SAP audits in alignment with cybersecurity standards.
- Project Management & Service Leadership: Ideate, steer, and deliver complex technical projects to optimize ERP performance and transformations. Drive continuous improvement in partner service delivery and manage connectivity pipelines (REST/SOAP/RFC APIs, SAP Event Mesh) across cross-functional teams.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Education: Degree in Computer Science / Business Informatics OR a vocational degree as an IT Specialist with proven advanced training.
- Experience & Mindset: Multi-year track record in SAP BASIS and platform infrastructure administration for complex hybrid landscapes, paired with a project-leading mindset.
- Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of SAP NetWeaver, S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP HANA DB (Linux/Windows), SAP BTP, Cloud Connector, and SAP Cloud ALM.
- Communication: Excellent stakeholder management skills in complex, matrixed organizations.
- Languages: Proficient in English; German language skills are a strong advantage

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

- Conduct research and gather information on specific topics as required.
- Perform other ad-hoc duties as assigned by the supervisor.

TU Darmstadt stands for excellent and relevant science. We are playing a decisive role in shaping far-reaching processes of global change-from energy transition to artificial intelligence-through outstanding scientific knowledge and innovative academic programmes. We group our cutting-edge research into three fields: Energy and Environment, Information and Intelligence, Matter and Materials. We are a university with strong ties to the Frankfurt Rhine-Main metropolitan region and a very strong international focus. We are committed to European values and European integration.

The Centre for Synthetic Biology at TU Darmstadt is a university-wide interdisciplinary research initiative bringing together biologists and biochemists with computational scientists and machine learning researchers. The PhD candidate will conduct research in AI method development for the design of novel RNA molecules with application in advanced therapeutic modalities.
Work on an interdisciplinary topic at the intersection of machine learning / AI and synthetic biology
Learn the mathematics and algorithms of state-of-the-art RNA language models
Learn the mathematics and algorithms of state-of-the-art diffusion models for generation of new RNA and protein molecules
Advance AI methods and models for the design of novel RNA molecules that get conditionally activated upon binding of specific diagnostic RNA molecules
Find novel ways to Incorporate structure and sequence information in RNA AI-models.
Build novel AI models for quantitative functional prediction of RNA designs
Work in close collaboration with experimentalists that conduct high-throughput assays for the characterization of these novel RNA molecules

An excellent university science degree (Master’s/Diploma) in computer science, electrical engineering, physics or mathematics. Master’s/Diploma degree must be completed prior to the start of employment.
Very good programming skills in python; finished larger scientific software projects
Advanced academic training / background in machine learning and AI methods.
Experience with dedicated AI methods for molecular design is a big plus.
Solid understanding of molecular biology and cell biology is a big plus.
Willingness and drive to work on an interdisciplinary project beyond traditional boundaries.

Fluency in English for communication in an international team and for writing scientific publications

Analytical thinking and a high degree of self-organization

a cover letter explaining succinctly why you want to join this project
your CV

jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

As a Product Quality Engineer, you will be expected to step into the game and display your excellent quality mindset to help drive our innovations beyond industry standards

What you will do

- Represent the Quality Management within the development team
- Correlate the SiC failure mechanisms with reliability measures to be implemented into the product quality
- Support the definition and execution of qualification activities for SiC product developments
- Contribute to the implementation of quality procedures and quality standards (Nexperia, JEDEC, AEC, and customer-specific) within projects
- Support the development, review, and verification of final test specifications
- Promote quality awareness and best practices to internal and external stakeholders
- Support customer requests and complaints handling activities
- Contribute to the identification and resolution of quality gaps in the product creation process
- Support the definition of qualification requirements and qualification of manufacturing processes
- Maintain documentation and handle data in analysis tools for Reliability, Yield, FMEA, Customer Requests, and related activities
- Perform analyses to identify root causes of yield loss or production issues and support the implementation of containment and corrective actions
- Prepare initial input for PCNs, support review and release activities, and contribute to follow-up actions

What you will need

- Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Physics or a similar discipline
- Experience in a similar position is desirable and experienced in wafer fab and assembly processes preferred
- Knowledge in semiconductor physics as well as in semiconductor applications in the SiC domain
- First knowledge of international quality standards and policies e.g. AEC-Q101, AQG 324
- Familiar with measurement methods and equipment as well as device testing environments
- Familiar with standard software tools (e.g. Office), problem solving techniques
- High-quality mindset and ability to work under pressure
- Fluent spoken and written English skills
- Strong know how in statistical data analysis
- Good communication and presentation skills
- Good team player and willingness to travel
- Assertiveness and demonstrated influencing skills
- Open mindset, which welcomes changes and views problems as opportunities

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support Engineering Business, Airbus is looking for a

V&V Solution Architect (d/f/m)

As part of the "Flight Test and Avionics" Team (DPSF), you will join the Aircraft and Electrical System Product Service Line responsible for developing and maintaining solutions for Flight Test and Avionics. The organization delivers a single, harmonized set of IS/IT tools for Aircraft, Helicopters, and Defense products across non-recurring and recurring lifecycle phases. In this role, you will drive the development and support of Product Life Cycle Management (PLM) solutions aligned with Airbus Group Process, Method, and Tools strategies, focusing on Digital Integrated Processes (Authoring) and Engineering Processes.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Alternate location is Toulouse, France.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement; work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Drive the E2E PLM Portfolio roadmap as an Enterprise/Functional Architect to define IS convergence strategies for Large Solutions.
- Design and communicate a shared technical vision while building the Architectural Runway to sustain long-term business value.
- Partner with Solution Train Engineers and Product Management to steer the operational delivery of the Large Solution.
- Coordinate across multiple Agile Release Trains (ARTs) to ensure seamless System Integration and technical alignment.
- Lead architecture boards and facilitate key SAFe ceremonies, including PI Planning, to govern technical standards.
- Secure project milestones by providing deep functional expertise and contributing to strategic roadmap definitions.
- Manage supplier team performance, providing the leadership and monitoring necessary to scale architectural activities.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor of Organic Chemistry (f/m/d) (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description:
Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Our principles are first-class teaching and research, international diversity, and multidisciplinary cooperation. Constructor University consistently achieves top results in national and international university rankings. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, over 1.800 students from 110 nations live and study on our residential campus.

Constructor University is seeking to fill a tenure-track faculty position in organic chemistry with a focus on synthetic organic chemistry, and we invite applications from interested candidates for the following position, to be filled ideally by January 2027:

Assistant Professor of Organic Chemistry (f/m/d)
(full-time, tenure-track, initially limited to 3 years)

Your Responsibilities:

The School of Science is particularly interested in a candidate who combines experimental and computational or theoretical approaches for the development of synthetic methodology and synthesis of bioactive molecules or functional materials. The implementation of AI, machine learning, or data-driven control / optimization is highly welcome, for example, for synthesis planning, activity prediction, sensing, or structural topology. The successful candidate is expected to engage in innovative research in organic chemistry and to maintain a cutting-edge, externally funded research program that energizes the School of Science.

The successful candidate will conduct teaching in the field of organic chemistry, including fundamental and advanced lectures and laboratories at the BSc, MSc, and PhD level. The expertise in teaching organic chemistry forms an integral part of the basic education in the BSc programs “Chemistry and Biotechnology” and “Medicinal Chemistry and Chemical Biology”. Moreover, the candidate is expected to take a pivotal role in the MSc programs “Quantitative Life Science” and/or “Advanced Materials” with complementary research experience and via the development and implementation of innovative, pedagogically sound approaches to online, hybrid and in-person teaching and learning. This will also include the advising of students on their studies, and the supervision of Bachelor, Master, and PhD theses as well as research projects.

The university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. The University offers in-house adequate shared analytical research facilities, including NMR spectrometers, single crystal diffractometers, and high-resolution mass spectrometers.                                                            

Your Qualifications and Experience:

- PhD degree in Organic Chemistry
- Strong publication record in relevant international journals
- Experience in the acquisition of third-party funding is desirable
- Experience in successful teaching in international and diverse environments, integrating innovative teaching and learning approaches.
- Inclination for collaboration with CU faculty and for transfer of research knowledge into applications
- Responsible, self-motivated person able to work independently and as a part of a team
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus
- Intercultural experience and competence
- Ideally, the successful candidate should be eligible for an ERC starting grant.
